data.name: NullIsValueHelp
data.value: When this Synchronization Rule applies to a Connected System Object that is joined to a Metaverse Object, but contributes no value, treat that as an authoritative "no value": clear the Metaverse Object attribute value rather than falling back to a lower-priority contributor. A rule that results in no opinion (rule disabled, Connected System Object not joined, or out of scope) is skipped regardless.

data.name: NullIsValueWarning
data.value: Wherever this Synchronization Rule wins priority, a blank in the Connected System now clears the Metaverse Object attribute value rather than leaving it alone. A truncated or empty import therefore clears the attribute across every object this rule covers.

To always flow a value, target a Multi-Valued attribute or use an Expression to select one.
